about: Flutter meter v5. Written and committed BEFORE v5 is run on its test clips. SPLIT.json is not edited. The v4 FAIL stays on the record.
why_v4_failed_in_part: v4 read the 25 Hz line from the nearest FFT bin of a 19.5 s clip. 25 Hz x 19.5 s = 487.5, exactly half way between two bins, so the Hann window reads the line about 15 % low (scalloping). The earlier 20.0 s development clips had the line exactly on a bin, so development looked fine and the test looked bad. That was my slip, not a property of the idea.

meter_v5.reading: Same band (5-15 kHz, 4th order Butterworth, zero phase), same Hilbert envelope, same 200 Hz low-pass as v4. The 25 Hz line is then read at EXACTLY 25.000 Hz by a direct sum over the Hann-windowed, mean-removed envelope (complex value A, divided by the mean envelope). No FFT bin is used.
meter_v5.self_calibration (standard addition): The meter adds a known extra flutter of depth 0.20 to the clip twice, once with phase 0 and once with phase 90 degrees, reads A1 and A2, and sets g = mean(|A1 - A0|, |A2 - A0|) / 0.20. g is 'reading per unit of true depth' for THIS clip. Depth reported = |A0| / g. If |A1-A0| and |A2-A0| differ by more than 15 %, the meter says 'not linear on this clip' and reports nothing.
refuses_when: the two calibration readings differ by more than 15 %

test.clips: The 9 human reference files that no flutter test or development run has used: ranked by 8-20 kHz share minus 5-10 kHz share, indices 24 and up, excluding the 10 clips of check 4b. First 19.5 s of each.
test.trials: Each clip gets a flutter of depth 0.15, 0.30 and 0.45 added (random phase, seed 5150): 27 trials. Only 9 unused clips exist, so there are 27 trials, not 10 clips.
test.ok_when: |estimated depth - injected depth| <= 0.20 x injected depth + natural depth of that clip, where natural depth is the meter's own estimate on the clip with nothing added. (Human cymbals already wobble a little, and that wobble adds to or takes from the injected one by up to its own size.)
test.if_it_fails: Flutter stays detect-only. The failure goes in FAILURES.md. The meter is not changed again on these clips.

also_reported: The natural depth found in every clip, and the g value per clip. Both are results, not pass/fail.
